name: Salvador
tagline: Afro-Brazilian heart with a colourful old town
summary: Salvador da Bahia was Brazil's first capital and the heart of Afro-Brazilian culture. Explore the pastel Pelourinho, ride the Lacerda Elevator, hear drumming and capoeira, eat acarajé and relax on beaches.
seasonNote: September to March is drier; Carnival in February is huge.
gettingAround: Uber and walking in the historic centre.
cashTip: Cards and Pix are everywhere; carry a little cash for beach vendors and keep valuables out of sight.
buyTip: Fitinhas ribbons, art and percussion instruments.
